name: Spark Forge AWS
summary: AWS-native Spark engineering specialist: Glue, EMR, Lake Formation, S3, Athena, Iceberg and the AWS lakehouse. Produces reviewed Spark/AES work through its own native surface; The Forge routes to it, it does not teach it Spark.
appropriate_for: PySpark/Spark jobs on AWS (Glue jobs, EMR steps, Spark on EC2/EKS)
AWS lakehouse work: Lake Formation governance, Glue Catalog, Athena queries, S3 tables, Iceberg tables
Spark performance analysis (event logs, Spark UI, physical plans, skew/spill) on AWS estates

API design or contract work â€” route to api-forge
platform/IDP engineering â€” route to platform-forge

install.command: python3.11 -m venv <spark-venv> && <spark-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <spark-python> -m pip install "sparkforge-aws>=0.5,<0.6" <the-forge>/adapters/sparkforge_aws
prerequisites: python>=3.11 on PATH or via uv/pyenv

limitations_note: AWS-only: no Azure/GCP signal. Doctors verify its output; it does not verify itself.
examples: analyze a Glue job that spills to disk
review Lake Formation grants for a curated zone
optimize an Iceberg compaction on the AWS lakehouse
